articles.summary: The Buckle, Inc. (NYSE: BKE) announced today that net income for the fiscal quarter ended August 1, 2026 was $44.4 million, or $0.88 per share ($0.87 per share on a diluted basis). Net sales for the 13-week fiscal quarter ended August 1, 2026 increased 4.6 percent to $319.8 million from net sales of $305.7 million for the prior year 13-week fiscal quarter ended August 2, 2025.
